title: 第2587章 都凌晨了她一个人出去第2586章 最大的阻碍是他们自己
lines: 追她的男生不少，可是没有一个，哪怕是跟她在一起的贺礼彬，都没有给过她心跳加速，小鹿乱撞的感觉。
翻来覆去，慕念安在床上不知道躺了多久，还是没有睡下。
她起床看了一眼时间，已经凌晨一点多了。
“哎。”她叹气，“再这样下去，我都快要精神衰弱了。”
她起身喝了杯水，在房间里转悠了两圈，还是一点睡意都没有。
干脆……下楼吧。
慕念安披了一件薄外套，穿上拖鞋，静悄悄的走出了房间。
这个时间点，佣人们都休息了。
客厅里只点着一盏灯，照着大概的布局轮廓。
慕念安也不想打扰别人，一直都把脚步放得非常轻。
凌晨气温低，有点凉，好在她穿了外套。
她走出别墅，不巧，值勤的保安，很快就发现了她，拿电筒直直的照着她：“谁？”
慕念安被强烈的灯光刺得都睁不开眼，伸手挡住，下意识的回答：“是我是我。”
“慕小姐？”保安听出了她的声音，连忙把手电筒给关了，“这么晚了，您怎么会出现在这里？”
“睡不着，所以随便走走。”
“抱歉抱歉，我不知道是您，刚才冒犯了……”
“没关系。”慕念安说，“不怪你，你也是在履行自己的职责而已。”
“您需要外出吗？”保安问道，“现在这个时间，您一个人的话，可能会有点危险，我叫人跟着您吧。”
“不用。”慕念安摇摇头，“我不会走远，就在这附近走走散散。”
“放心吧，这里的治安本来就很好，何况还有你们。我就在附近，要是有什么事大喊一声，你们也都听到了。”
慕念安说的，也的确有道理。
保安迟疑着点点头，叮嘱道：“那，慕小姐，您千万不要走远了。”
慕念安拢了拢身上的外套，从旁边的侧门，走出了别墅。
风很凉，但是能够把人吹得更加清醒。
慕念安沿着人工湖，慢慢的走着。
身后别墅的灯光，一直都亮着，她回头转身就可以看到。
都这个时间点了，路上自然是没有人。
挺好的。
清净。
content_en:
There were many boys chasing her, but none of them, not even He Libin who was with her, had ever made her heart beat faster and her heart beat like a deer.
Tossing and turning, Mu Nianan lay on the bed for who knows how long, but still didn't fall asleep.
She got up and looked at the time. It was already past one in the morning.
"Hey." She sighed, "If this continues, I'm going to have a nervous breakdown."
She got up, drank a glass of water, and walked around the room twice, but she still didn't feel sleepy at all.
Just...go downstairs.
Mu Nian'an put on a thin coat and slippers and walked out of the room quietly.
At this time, the servants all took a break.
There was only one lamp burning in the living room, illuminating the general outline of the layout.
Mu Nian'an didn't want to disturb others, so he kept his steps very light.
The temperature was low in the early morning and it was a bit chilly. Fortunately, she wore a coat.
She walked out of the villa. Unfortunately, the security guard on duty quickly spotted her and pointed a flashlight at her: "Who?"
Mu Nian'an was so blinded by the strong light that he couldn't even open his eyes. He stretched out his hand to block it and subconsciously replied: "It's me, it's me."
"Miss Mu?" The security guard heard her voice and quickly turned off the flashlight, "Why are you here so late?"
"I couldn't sleep, so I took a walk."
"I'm sorry, I didn't know it was you, I just offended you..."
"It doesn't matter." Mu Nian'an said, "I don't blame you, you are just fulfilling your responsibilities."
"Do you need to go out?" the security guard asked. "At this time, it may be a bit dangerous for you to be alone. I will ask someone to follow you."
"No need." Mu Nian'an shook his head, "I won't go far, I'll just take a walk around here."
"But..."
"Don't worry, the security here is already very good, not to mention you. I'm nearby. If something happens and I shout, you will hear it."
What Mu Nian'an said does make sense.
The security guard nodded hesitantly and warned: "Then, Miss Mu, you must not go too far."
"Okay."
Mu Nianan gathered her coat and walked out of the villa through the side door.
The wind is very cold, but it can make people feel more awake.
Mu Nian'an walked slowly along the artificial lake.
The lights of the villa behind her were always on, and she could see them when she turned around.
It was already this time, so naturally there was no one on the road.
fine.
Pure.
title_en: Chapter 2587 It was early in the morning and she went out alone Chapter 2586 The biggest obstacle is themselves
